description: This file defines the NumberFormat class for handling number formatting styles within the PhpSpreadsheet library's XML style parsing component. It includes a method to parse style attributes from XML into style configuration arrays, specifically for number formats.

classes.name: NumberFormat
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing number formatting styles from XML attributes into internal style representation within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: parseStyle
methods.description: Parses XML style attributes related to number formatting, replacing specific patterns, handling date formats, and returning the style configuration array.
